This procedure details the testing procedures and 
calibration I1, which recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block..

The type CFD relays are used for differential protection of 
alternating current machines against phase to phase and phase to ground faults. 
For an internal fault the relay will close its contacts. If on external fault 
therefore the relay will not operate.

The first draft initiated by Eng. Reda El Shenawey, tested 
by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa , and accepted by 
general manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This 
 document is revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel-Gil;il: MDEPC quality control general director, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This procedure details the testing procedures and 
calibration I1, which recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block..
The type CFD relays are used for differential protection of 
alternating current machines against phase to phase and phase to ground faults. 
For an internal fault the relay will close its contacts. If on external fault 
therefore the relay will not operate.
The first draft initiated by Eng. Reda El Shenawey, tested 
by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa , and accepted by 
general manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.
This 
 document is revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel-Gil;il: MDEPC quality control general director, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
Issue work permit 
 including the team work name.
The generator must be 
 out of service.
Put C.B of unit at 
 test position.
Disconnect excitation 
 system for A.C. generator (switch off "41 AC" breaker).
Tools and 
Equipment
Secondary injection test set.
Clamp meter, Test leads
AVO meter
Complete tool set.
Air blower.
Contact 
 cleaner (CRC).
Work to be carried out
Preparation
Look at field maintenance file and 
 compare the setting on relay with those shown on the test sheet.
Testing the Relay
Connect test leads between the 
 current terminals ( 5 6 ) figure 1
Increase the current slowly until the relay energize and 
 regist (P.U) value
Increase the current slowly until the relay denergize and regist (rest) value
Make sure that lock out relay operate with diff. relay 
 energize
Record these value in the test sheet
Connect the test leads between the current terminals 
 (7-6)
Repeat steps (2&3&4&5) for terminals (7-6)
Repeat all above steps for phases (S&T)
Remove relay 52 GTX
Close C.B for the unit at test position
Trip C.B for the init by differential
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service
Disconnect the test leads from the Relay.
Make sure 
 CT and PT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Make reset to lock out 
 relay and reset alarm indication
Reconnect excitation 
 system for A.C generator switch on "41 AC" breaker
Reconnect relay 52GTX
Put C.B in service 
 position .(make sure the spring of the C.B on discharge position)

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة بالتفصيل إجراءات الاختبار والمعايرة I1، التي يُوصى بتنفيذها كل سنة كما هو موضح بـ Y1 في خانة العنوان..

تُستخدم أجهزة الوقاية من النوع CFD للوقاية التفاضلية للآلات ذات التيار المتردد ضد الأعطال بين الأطوار وبين الطور والأرض. وعند حدوث عطل داخلي يغلق جهاز الوقاية تلامساته. أما عند حدوث عطل خارجي فلن يعمل جهاز الوقاية.
أعد المسودة الأولى م. Reda El Shenawey، واختبرها م. Khalied Diab وم. Ehab Abuo Elwafa، وقبلها المدير العام م. Saad Kheder، واعتمدها م. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby رئيس قطاع محطة Mahmoudia Power Station.
راجع هذه الوثيقة م. Adel El-Naggar: مهندس مراقبة الجودة في MDEPC، وقبلها م. Samir Abdel-Gilil: المدير العام لمراقبة الجودة في MDEPC، ووثقها م. Mohamed Naguib: رئيس قطاع مراقبة الجودة.
